assumptions.description: Fixed positive Gaussian-copula reference. Source moment constraints are fitted separately in their declared source contexts; no cross-source loss or target fitting.

Unspecified continuous dependence is completed by a latent-Gaussian entropy objective. Independent binary sex is a declared simplification. Local constrained optimization does not certify a global entropy optimum.

Source moments describe a qualified equal-weight analysis-population scenario. Known glucose/age support is represented in the declared margins; unavailable selection variables, assay differences and survey weights remain limitations.
Target biomarkers inherit the source-context marginal/copula laws through a prespecified donor rule. This is an unverified transport assumption, not target population estimation.
Published point summaries are fixed inputs. No source-estimate, structural or transport uncertainty is calibrated. SDs remain individual variability; SEs are not converted to SDs.
One random draw under each scheduled seed, without moment forcing, clipping, seed selection, rejection redraws or calibration inside the generator. Invalid floating-point output fails the attempt.
The exact eight age/sex quotas are the supplied analytical design. Age is uniform over integers within each band. Those target quotas are not substituted into the Lifelines source operator.

Pani age coefficient and age-band means remain contextual/unfitted because source individual dispersion, age law and survey weighting are not bound. No full Pani uptake or numerical source-fit claim is made.
The bound research task determines case, row count, variables, units and explicit support/design; no reference outcome supplies these values.
The bound E0/E1 packet determines the allowed source information. The reference's actual numerical uptake and declined records are retained in the separate construction trace.
